python -c "
import os, sys
workspace_root = 'C:\\oh\\Materials'
sys.path.insert(0, workspace_root)
print('sys.path[0]:', sys.path[0])
print('exists?', os.path.exists(os.path.join(workspace_root, 'phase1_pipeline.py')))
import importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('phase1_pipeline', os.path.join(workspace_root, 'phase1_pipeline.py'))
print('spec?', spec)
if spec and spec.loader:
    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
    print('loaded module:', mod)
    print('has build_feature_matrix?', hasattr(mod, 'build_feature_matrix'))
"
